To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
skydiving is a high-risk activity where the individual sky diver’s judgment is the most important factor for the safety.
injuries in skydiving can be understood as a part of skydivers’ recreational value and are related to the full skydive phase, and that injury reporting is influenced by drop zone culture.
injuries and incident reports are viewed as an integrated part of skydiving.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the human factors in skydiving and the importance of a safety culture in skydiving.
how the culture of skydiving influences the experience of injuries.
how the culture of skydiving may influence safety work, and how safety work may influence the culture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current safety work and incident/injury reporting in the Swedish skydiver culture is not working.
the skydiving community is in need of more education and training to understand and practice safety work and injury prevention.
the skydiving community in Sweden is characterized by a strong sense of community and loyalty to the drop zone.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
skydiving is a complex and multifaceted activity, which is not always easy to understand from the outside, but which is also not always easily understood from within.
the skydiving culture is characterized by a high degree of self-regulation, and that this culture has a strong impact on the safety work and incident/injury reporting within Swedish skydiving.
safety work and injury prevention in recreational skydiving is an ongoing and dynamic process, where the skydiving community is the main actor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the skydiving culture needs to be understood before any safety work can be initiated.
skydivers need to be encouraged to report injuries, and to be supported by the organization and leadership in the process of reporting.
the safety culture within skydiving may need to be improved to reduce the risk of injury.
